description: Connect or replace a proof-point provider on one product and run the first read. MRR providers: stripe, paddle, polar, revenuecat, lemon-squeezy, dodo-payments. Uptime: betterstack, cloudwatch, gcp-monitoring. Traffic: google-analytics. cadence is daily, weekly, or monthly. points list field_name and display_mode (exact, band, or hidden). Hidden keeps the field connected and synced but omits it from the public listing. CloudWatch token is JSON with accessKeyId and secretAccessKey; region is required. GCP Monitoring and Google Analytics token is the service account JSON. monitor_id, canary_name, check_id, property_id, project_id (RevenueCat), and store_id (Lemon Squeezy) disambiguate when more than one resource matches.
name: connect_proof_point
